If you enjoy the process, it’s a great habit to maintain! It’s also worth noting that grooming can be a form of mindfulness—focusing on the present moment rather than rushing through the day. If you ever want to explore ways to make it even more meaningful (like pairing it with a favorite playlist or a calming drink), I’d be happy to brainstorm ideas with you.
